title: R’ Abbahu bar Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: “He said in the name of our teacher”—so the old Midrash Tehillim, chapter 107, cites it. Hyman identifies him as R’ Abba bar Acha, who always reports in the name of Rabbi, as explained in his entry.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The heading says Abbahu; Hyman identifies him with Abba bar Acha. “Our teacher” and “Rabbi” remain unnamed designations in this notice.

The OYW digital Midrash Tehillim 107:4 reads R’ Abbahu beRabbi Acha in the name of “our teacher.” This is a digital parallel, not a fresh collation of Hyman’s old printed edition. His identification with R’ Abba bar Acha, and his claim that the latter always reports in Rabbi’s name, remain his assertions; abbreviated titles are not expanded by assuming that identification.
